short_description: The group ventures down an unfamiliar path through the forest

text_blocks.content: Exchanging a silent nod, the group sets off down an obscured path leading deeper into the forest. The familiar landmarks quickly fade as they venture into the unknown, the whispers of The Veil growing louder with each step.
I don't recognize this part of the grove. The wards feel... different here.
Stay alert. We're moving into uncharted territory.
*A mischievous grin* Oh, this is where the real adventure begins.
*pauses, listening intently* The Veil... it's pulling us deeper. I can feel its influence growing stronger.

The group presses on, the dense foliage obscuring their path and the fading wards offering little reassurance. Shadows seem to shift and twist at the edge of their vision, as if the very forest itself is alive and watching their every move.
